Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

big — large in size. Example: The city is bigger.
small — little in size. Example: This phone is smaller.
fast — moving quickly. Example: The train is faster than the bus.
slow — moving without speed. Example: The bus is slower than the train.
cheap — not expensive. Example: This phone is cheaper.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• It is bigger than ...
• She is taller than ...
• It is cheaper than ...
• Which is faster?
• Much bigger.
Vocabulary practice: choose the correct word.
Which word means 'large in size'?
Which word means 'little in size'?
Complete the sentence with a word from the list.
than is weak: /ðən/.
faster thən the bus
Listen and repeat three times.
Which word carries the main stress?
Grammar focus: Comparative adjectives (-er than, more ... than).
Compare with -er than: My car is faster than yours. Big becomes bigger. Use more + adjective for long words: more expensive than.
Controlled practice: choose the correct option.
Choose the correct form.
Choose the correct sentence.
options: The train is faster than the bus.
The train is more fast than the bus.
The train is faster that the bus.
